P: 1. Arrange immediate emergency evaluation; obtain ECG, chest x-ray and a validated pretest assessment to guide CTPA or D-dimer testing; discuss anticoagulation only after bleeding risk and urgent clinician evaluation; explain why a lung clot must be excluded and use EMS rather than self-driving.
2. Obtain chest x-ray and CBC during urgent assessment; consider antibiotics only if infection is supported; explain that fever may be absent and reassess the clinical course.
3. Urgently assess bilateral ventilation and obtain chest imaging if stable; involve the emergency team for decompression if tension physiology develops; explain return/emergency precautions.

P: 1. Arrange immediate emergency evaluation; obtain ECG, chest x-ray and a validated pretest assessment to guide CTPA or D-dimer testing; discuss anticoagulation only after bleeding risk and urgent clinician evaluation; explain why a lung clot must be excluded and use EMS rather than self-driving.

P: 1. Arrange immediate emergency evaluation; obtain ECG, chest x-ray and a validated pretest assessment to guide CTPA or D-dimer testing; discuss anticoagulation only after bleeding risk and urgent clinician evaluation; explain why a lung clot must be excluded and use EMS rather than self-driving. Ask permission to contact a support person and arrange EMS; explain why driving while acutely breathless is unsafe.
2. Obtain chest x-ray and CBC during urgent assessment; consider antibiotics only if infection is supported; explain that fever may be absent and reassess the clinical course.
3. Urgently assess bilateral ventilation and obtain chest imaging if stable; involve the emergency team for decompression if tension physiology develops; explain return/emergency precautions.
